headline_pain: What If Your Super Worked Harder?
primary_text: "Can I actually buy a warehouse through my super? The rules seem complicated." What if your superannuation could buy you a brand-new warehouse — and your business pays rent back into your own fund? That's exactly how SMSF commercial property works. You build super wealth while your business gets a home. These Truganina warehouses are SMSF-eligible and purpose-built for small business owner-occupiers. 20km from Melbourne CBD with Princes Freeway access. Is your super working as hard as you are? Find out if SMSF ownership suits your situation.
description: Your business pays rent into your own super fund — building your retirement
